mechanic:break_mine.art_style: Stylized bright simulator look in ~8/12; 3 dark anime/event icons.
avoid: Dark palettes for a casual dig game
mechanic:break_mine.direction: Icon: an excavator or giant pickaxe biting into a snowy peak with rocks flying. Thumbnail: diagonal split, untouched mountain left, flattened ground right, with money totals.
do: Show a huge target being broken (mountain, car, building)
Put a machine or tool in the act of breaking it
Add a diagonal split before/after with dollar values
Keep sky blue and grass green

icon_patterns.pattern: Tool or machine mid-impact (pickaxe, bat, wrecking ball, excavator)

mechanic:break_mine.newcomer_shift: NEW games go big-object: flatten a whole mountain, crash cars, mech vs kaiju — scale of destruction is the hook.
mechanic:break_mine.summary: Break/dig games show the tool hitting the target (pickaxe, excavator, wrecking ball) on bright skies, with $0→$1,000,000 or before/after splits.
mechanic:break_mine.text_usage: Text mostly absent on icons; thumbnails use big money numbers or power totals.

mechanic:clicker.art_style: Mostly stylized/simulator_bright (~8/12) with anime and greyscale outliers.

do: Use one glowing subject with strong rim light
Show the tap result as a big number
Keep saturation high

mechanic:clicker.newcomer_shift: NEW games: voxel horror screenshots, money tier panels, first-person neon shooters.

mechanic:clicker.text_usage: Minimal; numbers and short labels (YOU!, +99B, DAY 201).

thumbnail_patterns.pattern: Bright simulator scene with numbers or pet card

Add a rarity or $/s label

Add a tiny odds number in rainbow text
Use radial lightning/sparkle bursts behind the card

Card, pack or dice held up or shown prominently
